title: Two-Ball Rhythm Dribble
setup: One player with two basketballs in an athletic stance.
steps: Dribble both balls at the same height.
Keep knees bent and eyes forward.
Progress to alternating the dribbles.
progression: Change dribble heights or walk forward while maintaining rhythm.

title: Figure-8 Cone Weave
setup: Place two cones about six feet apart.
steps: Dribble around the first cone.
Cross between the cones.
Continue around the second cone to create a figure-eight path.
progression: Require a crossover at the center of the figure eight.

title: One-Hand Form Shooting
setup: Stand 3 to 5 feet from the basket.
steps: Place the shooting hand under the ball.
Extend upward toward the rim.
Hold the follow-through until the ball reaches the basket.
progression: Back up one step after making three controlled shots.

title: Layup Footwork Progression
setup: Start several steps from the basket at a 45-degree angle.
steps: Walk through the final two steps without a ball.
Add the ball and controlled dribble.
Finish softly off the backboard.
progression: Alternate sides and add a passive defender.

title: Hesitation & Go
setup: Use a cone or defender near the perimeter.
steps: Attack under control.
Briefly rise and slow the dribble.
Drop low and explode past the obstacle.
progression: Add a live defender and require a finish.

title: Retreat Dribble Press Break
setup: Ballhandler begins under controlled defensive pressure.
steps: Protect the ball with the body.
Retreat diagonally to create space.
Change direction and attack the open lane.
progression: Use a second defender to simulate a trap.

title: Give & Go
setup: Two offensive players on the perimeter with a defender or cone.
steps: Pass to the teammate.
Immediately cut toward the basket.
Receive the return pass in stride and finish.
progression: Add a live defender denying the return pass.

title: Defensive Slide Box
setup: Arrange four cones in a rectangle.
steps: Begin in a low defensive stance.
Slide laterally to each cone without crossing the feet.
Stay square while changing directions.
progression: Coach points randomly to determine direction.

title: Drop-Step Pivot Footwork
setup: Start on the low block with back or shoulder toward the basket.
steps: Establish the pivot foot.
Drop the opposite foot toward the baseline or lane.
Protect the ball and finish strong.
progression: Read a live defender and select the correct direction.

title: Hit-Find-Go Rebounding
setup: Place an offensive player and defender near the lane with a coach or shooter.
steps: Make legal body contact on the shot.
Turn and locate the basketball.
Pursue the rebound with two hands.
progression: Play live after the rebound with an outlet target.

title: Catch-and-Shoot Spots
setup: Choose three perimeter shooting locations.
steps: Move into the first spot ready to shoot.
Catch on balance and shoot immediately.
Relocate quickly to the next spot.
progression: Add a closing defender or timed makes goal.

title: Closeout & Contain
setup: Defender starts in the paint; ballhandler starts on the perimeter.
steps: Sprint toward the ballhandler.
Shorten steps and arrive balanced.
Influence the drive and slide to contain.
progression: Play live for three dribbles after the closeout.

title: Partner Bounce Pass
setup: Partners 6–8 feet apart with one basketball.
steps: Step toward your partner.
Bounce the pass about two-thirds of the way across.
Catch under control and return the pass.
progression: Increase the distance while maintaining accuracy.

title: Triangle Pass & Follow
setup: Three players form a 10-foot triangle with one basketball.
steps: Pass clockwise to the next player.
Immediately follow your pass to that spot.
Continue around the triangle, then reverse direction.
progression: Add a second ball once spacing and communication are consistent.

title: Shuffle & Pass
setup: Partners start about 8 feet apart in parallel lanes.
steps: Shuffle together down the court.
Exchange controlled chest passes while moving.
Stop at the cone and return.
progression: Increase pace while keeping passes on target.

title: Bank Shot Targets
setup: Start 3–5 feet from the basket at a 45-degree angle.
steps: Square up under control.
Aim at the upper near corner of the backboard square.
Take five controlled shots from each side.
progression: Move back one step after consistent makes.

title: Elbow Shot Shuttle
setup: Place cones at both free-throw elbows with a rebounder near the basket.
steps: Catch and shoot at one elbow.
Move immediately to the opposite elbow.
Partner rebounds and passes; switch after 10 shots.
progression: Set a makes goal or add a controlled closeout.

title: One-Dribble Pull-Up
setup: Place a cone on the wing and start with the ball behind it.
steps: Attack past the cone using one dribble.
Gather into a legal balanced stop.
Rise straight into the pull-up jumper.
progression: Work both directions, then add a live defender.

title: Low–High Dribble Control
setup: One player with one ball in clear space.
steps: Dribble below knee height for 10 seconds.
Move to a controlled waist-high dribble for 10 seconds.
Repeat and switch hands.
progression: Alternate heights on the coach’s signal.

title: Crossover Cone Zigzag
setup: Stagger four cones 6–8 feet apart.
steps: Attack the first cone.
Use a low crossover to change direction.
Continue through all cones with controlled pace.
progression: Reduce cone spacing or add a finishing move at the basket.

title: In-and-Out Attack
setup: Start eight feet from a cone with one basketball.
steps: Attack the cone under control.
Fake the ball inward using the same dribbling hand.
Push the ball outward and accelerate past the cone.
progression: Add a live defender and finish at the rim.

title: Stationary V-Dribble
setup: One ball and clear space.
steps: Dribble side to side in front using the same hand.
Work 30 seconds per hand and repeat.
progression: Increase tempo while maintaining control.

title: Walking Weak-Hand Control
setup: Clear 20-foot lane with a cone.
steps: Walk to cone using weaker hand.
Turn under control and return for four trips.
progression: Progress from walking to a controlled jog.

title: Protect & Pivot Dribble
setup: Partner acts as stationary shadow defender.
steps: Keep dribbling while using body to shield ball.
Change facing direction without ending dribble; switch roles.
progression: Allow shadow defender to move slowly.

title: Close-Range Make & Move
setup: Three close shooting spots.
steps: Take three shots at each spot, then move.
progression: Move slightly farther only after consistent technique.

title: Step-In Ready Shot
setup: Partner and ball within comfortable range.
steps: Step toward pass, catch into balanced stop and shoot.
Switch after five attempts.
progression: Add a controlled pass from a new angle.

title: Free-Throw Routine
setup: Use regulation or closer practice line.
steps: Breathe and use the same routine before every attempt.
Aim, shoot and reset.
progression: Track makes across three sets.

title: Pass & Relocate Shooting
setup: Two players at wing and top/corner spots.
steps: Pass, relocate to corner, receive return pass and shoot.
Switch roles.
progression: Add a controlled closeout.

title: Curl-Cut Catch & Shoot
setup: Cone, partner and ball.
steps: Curl around cone, receive pass, stop legally and shoot.
Repeat both sides.
progression: Vary the cut angle.

title: Jump Stop & Freeze
setup: Two cones 10 feet apart.
steps: Jog slowly and make a low two-foot stop.
Freeze for two seconds and walk back.
progression: Add a ball after footwork is consistent.

title: Pivot Clock
setup: Three floor markers around a pivot spot.
steps: Keep one foot planted and step the other to each marker.
Switch pivot feet.
progression: Call markers randomly.

title: Jab Step & Reset
setup: Start in triple threat.
steps: Keep pivot foot planted, jab with other foot and reset.
Work both sides.
progression: Add a pass or drive read.

title: Front & Reverse Pivot
setup: One ball and clear space.
steps: Practice front pivot then reverse pivot.
Repeat using other pivot foot.
progression: Add a partner target after pivot.

title: V-Cut to Get Open
setup: Passer at top, receiver on wing.
steps: Cut in, plant under control, push back out and receive pass.
progression: Add a shadow defender.

title: Chest Pass Target
setup: Partners six feet apart.
steps: Step toward target and make a chest pass.
Catch softly and return.
progression: Increase distance gradually.

title: Overhead Pass to Partner
setup: Partners 8–10 feet apart.
steps: Bring ball above forehead, step and pass forward.
Partner returns.
progression: Add light movement before receiving.

title: Pivot & Pass to Target
setup: Three players in a wide triangle.
steps: Coach calls target; pivot legally and pass.
Rotate roles.
progression: Speed up the decision call.

title: Pass Fake & Find
setup: Passer, receiver and shadow defender.
steps: Fake one direction, step and pass through open lane.
progression: Allow defender to shadow slowly.

title: Three-Player Weave
setup: Three lanes, three players, one ball.
steps: Middle passes to side and follows behind receiver.
Repeat toward half court.
progression: Progress from walk to controlled jog.

title: Three-on-One Keep-Away
setup: Three passers around triangle and one defender.
steps: Keep possession using passes and legal pivots; no dribbling.
progression: Reduce space for added challenge.

title: Mirror Defensive Slides
setup: Partners six feet apart.
steps: Leader moves slowly side to side; defender mirrors without contact.
progression: Increase duration gradually.

title: Closeout to Stance
setup: Defender starts ten feet from stationary ballholder.
steps: Approach, shorten steps and stop in balanced stance.
progression: Add a pass after closeout.

title: Cut-Off the Drive
setup: Partners in wide lane.
steps: Attacker uses up to two slow dribbles; defender slides to stay between ball and basket.
progression: Increase attacker speed gradually.

title: Help & Recover
setup: Two offensive players and one wing defender.
steps: Step toward controlled drive to help; recover on pass.
progression: Add second defender.

title: Shell Rotation
setup: Four attackers outside lane and four defenders.
steps: Offense passes only; defenders shift into on-ball, help and recovery positions.
progression: Allow controlled drives after rotations are sound.

title: Rebound & Chin
setup: Partner makes gentle high toss.
steps: Catch with two hands, land softly and secure ball.
progression: Add a pivot after securing.

title: Find-Hit-Get
setup: Rebounder, shadow partner and coach.
steps: Find partner, establish legal position, pursue coach toss.
progression: Introduce controlled live contact.

title: Wall Rebound Timing
setup: Clear wall with adult supervision.
steps: Toss gently above shoulder height and catch return with two hands.
progression: Vary target height slightly.

title: Outlet After Rebound
setup: Coach, rebounder and sideline outlet.
steps: Secure rebound, pivot legally, see outlet and pass.
progression: Add a shadow defender.

title: Two-Player Box-Out Battle
setup: Matched partners and coach.
steps: Coach tosses; defender establishes legal position; both pursue under control.
progression: Play live only with controlled contact.

title: Weak-Side Rebound Read
setup: Shooter on wing, rebounder opposite side.
steps: Read shot flight, move to likely path and rebound with two hands.
progression: Vary shot locations.

title: Cone Adventure
setup: Use the marked space shown in the drill visual.
steps: Warm up first.
Perform the drill at the age-appropriate controlled dose shown on the card.
Walk or rest between efforts.
progression: Increase only when technique and recovery remain consistent.
